notes: streams from make_stream.sh: fragmented MP4, one fragment per second, 1080p30 H.264 at 12 Mbit/s and 4K30 HEVC at 40 Mbit/s
frame: a COSE signature with x5chain over every encoded access unit (upper bound, not a C2PA method)
manifest: C2PA 2.5 Section 15.4, a manifest with BMFF hash, live-video segment assertion and x5chain in every segment
vsi: C2PA 2.5 Section 15.5, chain and session key once, then a session-key-signed segment-info map in an emsg box per segment; the session key uses the signer's algorithm
fragments are hashed as they arrive; latency_after_close is hashing the last fragment plus signing
detected lists what the verifier reports for each manipulation of the stream; the verifier knows the stream id (and for VSI the initial manifest id) it is playing
cpu_fraction counts hashing every fragment of a segment and building and signing its provenance, over one core in real time
streams of make_stream.sh looped by stream copy to the length in env.streams_seconds
